records.name: HelloTest capability acceptance
records.description: Reusable HelloTest guidance. Saving a template does not invoke a model.
records.prompt_text: Write a HelloTest Story with persona, behavior, permission boundaries, acceptance criteria and delivery context. Use only supplied feature facts.

records.name: Complete a HelloTest Story
records.description: Reusable HelloTest guidance. Saving a template does not invoke a model.
records.prompt_text: Complete missing criteria, permissions, error recovery and traceability. Preserve existing scope and flag unsupported assumptions.

records.name: HelloTest access and feature coverage
records.description: Reusable HelloTest guidance. Saving a template does not invoke a model.
records.prompt_text: Create positive, negative, permission-revocation and disabled-feature cases. Include preconditions, parameters, explicit steps and expected results.

records.name: Improve HelloTest execution steps
records.description: Reusable HelloTest guidance. Saving a template does not invoke a model.
records.prompt_text: Clarify each action and expected result, preserve IDs and parameter tokens, and keep shared preconditions reusable.

records.name: HelloTest evidence-backed Defect
records.description: Reusable HelloTest guidance. Saving a template does not invoke a model.
records.prompt_text: Draft a concise title, description, environment, reproducible steps, expected and actual result, severity rationale and related records from supplied evidence. Mark missing evidence.
